quarterly_data.quarter: Element Solutions IR presentation: 2026 Third Quarter Financial Results Call (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 earnings deck, Electronics business lines (net sales and organic growth): Assembly $369 million, +16% (higher volume of high reliability paste and engineered products for datacenter applications); Circuitry $162 million, +16% ('AI-related demand for high layer count server boards'); Micromax $138 million (price and product mix drove 23% year-over-year ex-metal revenue growth; excluded from organic); Semiconductor $111 million, +24% (strong power electronics growth, increased wafer plating chemistry sales to OSATs and precious metals price inflation). Electronics adjusted EBITDA margin 32.2% (+230 bps). Specialties: Industrial $170 million (+3%, pricing and raw material surcharges offsetting soft automotive and construction), Energy $23 million (-13%, downtime at a large customer and EMEA project timing), EFC $23 million (electrical infrastructure strength and new satellite wins drove 19% revenue growth); Specialties adjusted EBITDA margin 19.8% (-390 bps).
quarterly_data.figure: Semiconductor $111 million (+24% organic); Circuitry $162 million (+16%); Assembly $369 million (+16%); Electronics margin 32.2%

quarterly_data.quarter: Element Solutions IR presentation: 2026 Third Quarter Financial Results Call (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 earnings deck, cash and capacity outlook: full-year 2026 net capex expected at roughly $110 million (Q3 $30 million, year to date $83 million), 'driven by continued investment in Kuprion sites and expansion in other growth products'; full-year cash interest ~$90 million and cash taxes ~$100 million; pro forma net debt to adjusted EBITDA 2.7x (LTM, including Micromax and EFC), expected to fall further by year end; the FY2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance of ~$720 million includes above-target compensation accruals, and the deck says electronics momentum is 'expected to continue into 2027'.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 net capex ~$110 million; net leverage 2.7x
